release_notes:
Logo fixes and more accurate service status in the admin panel

- Fixed the logo in the admin panel header sitting off-center in some layouts.
- Fixed the customer dashboard sometimes showing an old placeholder logo instead of your actual logo after an update.
- Fixed the API History section on a service's edit page sometimes showing "Active" for a service the system had already correctly turned off, or showing nothing at all after running a catalog sync — it now always reflects the real, current status.
- Reduced unnecessary "renamed by supplier" email alerts for services you never added to your catalog.
